prompt: bash history expansion q x modifiers combined behavior
answer:
The `q` and `x` modifiers are mutually exclusive. If combined, the **last one supplied takes effect**:

- `:qx` → `x` behavior
- `:xq` → `q` behavior

Source: [history(3) Linux manual](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man3/history.3.html)
